quality.title: Japanese-standard quality, in numbers
quality.subtitle: Since our 2008 joint venture with Japan's HOLLYHOCK, Lean Manufacturing and Kaizen run through every stage.
quality.story: Our production and quality management systems are modelled on Japanese principles of precision and continuous improvement. Every semi-finished product is inspected; any batch below a 95% first-pass yield is routed for comprehensive rework — so only products meeting our exacting criteria reach final assembly.
